evidence.detail: The Yes action clears the selected loadout equipment state, copies inventory/equipment widget contents from roots 3214 and 1688, copies client combat/appearance selections, and copies the configured skill levels.
Copied loadout skill values come from Client.eo through the loadout skill-index table and are clamped to 1..99.

After cloning it refreshes/persists the loadout views, writes Client.ap = "::cldt", and closes the confirmation frame; when no logged-in character exists it shows the exact wear-what-you-want-to-clone retry message.

proposals.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 loadout clone mutation; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 resolves the currently selected loadout, rejects a missing selection with "You don't have a loadout selected!", then opens a "Clone to <loadout>?" JFrame with Yes and No buttons.
The Yes button installs rs/gui/b/a/c and the No button installs rs/gui/b/a/d, proving this action owns the clone-confirmation dialog rather than the clone mutation itself.
